The Adderall Diet
I've been diagnosed with ADD since I was in first grade.  I at first took ritalin and was on that drug until I guess middle school.  I then was put on concerta and I took that for roughly 5 years.  I stopped taking it when I would suffer from depression caused by the medicine.  I then switched to Adderall XR.  At the time of my medication switch, I was 240 pounds.  This was in January '05.  As soon as I started taking the medication I completely lost my appetite.  I liked the fact that I didn't have any appetite and I kept with it.  Because of the fact that I was taking in much less food and my metabolism was sped up so much from the medicine, I rapidly began to lose weight.  By June I had lost 80 pounds, now weighing 160.  I've learned how to control my appetite on Adderall so I can eat normal food but I can see the power behind this drug.
